memory_candidates.content: When a plan's phase-by-phase gate sweep surfaces a verify-deploy.sh failure, the correct triage is: isolate each failing gate individually (e.g. re-run check-extension-docs.sh scoped to the touched extensions, diff the deployed vs. source copy of any 'content differs from source' finding) before assuming the task caused it. A failure is attributable to the current task only if the diff/evidence traces to a file this task touched; cross-extension deploy staleness flagged in the dispatch's own deploy-freshness-context, and files already dirty in git status at session start, are pre-existing and belong in a Reasoned Exclusions table (COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS) rather than blocking the phase as PARTIAL or silently ignored.

Adding one bullet/pointer line to an EXTENSION.md already sitting at exactly its Rule U 60-line cap can often be absorbed at ZERO net line growth by folding the addition into an existing sentence (appending text to a line rather than inserting a new physical line), since wc -l only counts newline characters, not visual wrap width. This avoids needing to find and execute a trim elsewhere in the same file.
